rules.title: CMake policy versions older than 3.5 are removed
rules.summary: CMake 4.0 removed compatibility with policy versions older than 3.5. A cmake_minimum_required(VERSION) or cmake_policy(VERSION) call that does not set the policy version to at least 3.5 (optionally via ...<policy_max>) produces an error on CMake 4.0 and newer. CMake 4.0.0 was published on 2025-03-27.
rules.replacement: cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5) or newer, or VERSION <min>...<max> with <max> at least 3.5

sources.title: CMake 4.0 release notes (compatibility older than 3.5 removed)

constraints: Raising the policy version can change NEW policy behavior; read the policies introduced between the old and new floor before committing.
Projects that must still configure on older CMake can use VERSION <min>...<max> so the minimum stays low while the policy max is at least 3.5 on newer CMake.

steps.title: Raise the reported cmake_minimum_required policy version
steps.instructions: Change the reported cmake_minimum_required(VERSION …) so the effective policy version is at least 3.5 (for example VERSION 3.16, or VERSION 2.8.12...3.16).

verification.purpose: Configure the project with a CMake 4.x toolchain and confirm the policy floor is accepted.

rules.title: CMake policy versions older than 3.10 are deprecated
rules.summary: CMake 3.31 deprecated compatibility with policy versions older than 3.10. A cmake_minimum_required(VERSION) or cmake_policy(VERSION) call that does not set the policy version to at least 3.10 (optionally via ...<policy_max>) produces a deprecation warning on CMake 3.31 and newer. CMake 3.31.0 was published on 2024-11-06. Versions older than 3.5 are covered by the removal rule instead.
rules.replacement: cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10) or newer, or VERSION <min>...<max> with <max> at least 3.10

sources.title: CMake 3.31 release notes (compatibility older than 3.10 deprecated)

constraints: Raising the policy version can change NEW policy behavior; read the policies introduced between the old and new floor before committing.

steps.title: Raise the reported cmake_minimum_required policy version
steps.instructions: Change the reported cmake_minimum_required(VERSION …) so the effective policy version is at least 3.10 (for example VERSION 3.16, or VERSION 3.5...3.16).

verification.purpose: Configure with developer warnings enabled and confirm the policy-floor deprecation is gone.

rules.title: The Visual Studio 12 2013 generator is removed
rules.summary: CMake 3.31 removed the Visual Studio 12 2013 generator. Projects and presets that still name that generator cannot configure on CMake 3.31 or newer. CMake 3.31.0 was published on 2024-11-06.
rules.replacement: A still-supported Visual Studio generator, such as Visual Studio 17 2022

sources.title: CMake 3.31 release notes (Visual Studio 12 2013 generator removed)

constraints: Update CMake presets, CI matrix generator names, and documented configure commands together so every surface names the same supported generator.

steps.title: Replace the Visual Studio 12 2013 generator
steps.instructions: Change every reported generator name from Visual Studio 12 2013 to a supported Visual Studio generator installed on the build hosts.

verification.purpose: Configure with a supported Visual Studio generator.

rules.title: The FindGDAL module is deprecated
rules.summary: CMake 4.0 deprecated the FindGDAL module in favor of upstream GDAL's official CMake package configuration file. Projects should call find_package(GDAL CONFIG) instead. CMake 4.0.0 was published on 2025-03-27.
rules.replacement: find_package(GDAL CONFIG) using GDAL's upstream CMake package

constraints: Confirm the GDAL install that the project uses ships a CONFIG package before dropping FindGDAL.
Target and variable names may differ between FindGDAL and the upstream CONFIG package; update link lines to match.

steps.title: Switch to find_package(GDAL CONFIG)
steps.instructions: Replace find_package(GDAL) / include(FindGDAL) with find_package(GDAL CONFIG) and link the imported targets the upstream package exports.

verification.purpose: Configure and build after the GDAL find_package change.

rules.title: The CMakeFindFrameworks module is deprecated
rules.summary: CMake 3.31 deprecated the CMakeFindFrameworks module via policy CMP0173. Projects should use find_library() instead. CMake 3.31.0 was published on 2024-11-06.

constraints: Preserve the framework search paths and the library names the project already expects when rewriting calls to find_library().

steps.title: Replace CMakeFindFrameworks with find_library
steps.instructions: Remove include(CMakeFindFrameworks) / cmake_find_frameworks() and locate the same frameworks with find_library().

verification.purpose: Configure with developer warnings and confirm the CMP0173 deprecation is gone.
